_note: "items" is empty -- this channel is entirely series-driven, same shape as channels/science, channels/pet-central and channels/comedy-club. Nine series back the 15-block, 24-hour daily grid in programming.json: eight real YouTube imports from six official publisher channels (Rick Steves' Europe; DW Travel; Geography Now; DW Documentary, as two playlists -- its 'Travel' and 'Train Ride Documentaries' playlists, with the overlap de-duplicated; Kara and Nate's long-form-only uploads playlist UULF<channel>; and Mark Wiens' long-form-only uploads playlist imported twice as two disjoint regional editorial series, Asia & the Middle East and Africa & Latin America, so each prime-time hour stays on one part of the map) plus one Internet Archive series of public-domain travelogues. See each series/<id>/series.json for the full episode list and per-episode editorial status/notes. YouTube episodes carry rights.status "unverified" (YouTube embed only; needs human rights review); IA episodes are approved only where IA itself declares public domain. Tourism-board-sponsored, hotel/resort/airline/cruise showcase and listicle uploads were rejected across every source.
